scope: Paired synthetic regression measurements with unchanged labels/requests. Historical-source and optional local-reranker checks are separate populations; no independent human-query, generated-answer, production-quality or latency claim.

changes.step1: For prose fully covered by ranked notes, limit inferred scope to verified live anchor symbols, without dependency/owner closure. Preserve explicit-symbol dependency expansion and incomplete-coverage fallback.
changes.step2: For narrowly parsed model-free attribute questions, withhold ranked and linked notes when topic stems excluding the code name have no support in authorized candidate notes or source text. Retain broad constraints, rationale, compound/unrecognized forms, explicit needs/rephrasings, semantic ranks and rerankers.
changes.diagnostics: memory_topic_support reports lexical candidate support and withheld counts; candidate selection_filter records unsupported_topic, and relevance_withheld is a reported recall failure stage without changing the gate.

python_quality_symbol_real_tests.skip: Optional local-model test; subsequently run with explicit model assets.

runtime_integration_initial.failure: Two pre-existing terminal-display assertions hard-coded 7 nodes. Starting and candidate binaries both produce the identical 8-node/10-edge graph.

validation.terminal_test_repair: Compare rendered node count with the structured sync result; preserve symbol/file count assertions.

limitations: Synonym-only attribute requests without lexical support may lose useful notes in model-free mode. Independent real-user coverage is still required.
The attribute recognizer is deliberately limited to English question forms; other forms retain existing behavior.
The optional reranker deliberately bypasses the new lexical filter; model-free precision gains are not claimed for the reranker.
No accepted baseline refresh, deployment, commit or PR was performed.
